name: TITAN
source:
A city filled with vibrant life sprawled in every corner. Luscious meadows. Luminous high-rises. Sparkling lakes. Glistening skies. A beautiful paradise. Heavens Fall was a utopia – perfect in every shape and form.

Behind the scenes, technology had revolutionized Heavens Fall and the society its people lived in, connecting every facet of life and reigniting intellectual curiosity. At the core of this transformation stood a central figure, an icon to whom the city owed its gratitude for its prosperity:

TITAN, the tech giant of Heavens Fall.

[From [url=https://vifergaming.itch.io/titan]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这座城市的每一个角落都充满了生机勃勃的活力。甘美的草地。灯火通明的高楼大厦。波光粼粼的湖泊。闪闪发光的天空。一个美丽的天堂。《天堂坠落》是一个乌托邦——各种形状和形式都很完美。

在幕后，技术彻底改变了《天堂坠落》及其人们所生活的社会，连接了生活的方方面面，并重新点燃了求知欲。这一转变的核心是一位核心人物，一位偶像，这座城市的繁荣归功于他：

TITAN，天堂陨落的科技巨头。

[来自[url=https://vifergaming.itch.io/titan]Itch.io[/url]]
